item.title: 🟠 Siemens Software Center Vulnerability Exploited in ClickFix Malware Attacks
item.description:
Why this matters: Hospitality-system impact — consider guest services, PMS/POS, and property operations.

Attackers paired a genuine, signed copy of Siemens Software Center with malicious DLLs to infect Windows PCs via ClickFix lures.

The post Siemens Software Center Vulnerability Exploited in ClickFix Malware Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: 🔴 Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
item.description:
Why this matters: Elevated ransomware risk — validate backups, endpoint protection, and recovery readiness.
U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. Sources close to the investigation say one of the executives in the United States even helped ShinyHunters operate a website that pressured victims into paying a ransom.

Source: Krebs on Security  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 11h

item.title: 🟠 Troubleshoot Hyper-V guarded fabrics and shielded VMs
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and watch for suspicious sign-ins.

Use this FAQ when a guarded fabric can't be deployed, a host can't attest, a shielded virtual machine (VM) can't be provisioned or started, or an operation such as migration, servicing, or recovery fails. It accompanies the Microsoft Learn module: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/guarded-fabric-shielded-virtual-machines/

 

Warning

Don't use TPM clearing, an unrelated new or local KP, disabled Secure Boot or CI, a weaker attestation mode, certificate-validation bypasses, or copied owner private keys as generic troubleshooting fixes. Don't delete protected VM state or checkpoint files to make an error disappear. These actions can weaken the trust boundary or permanently remove access to encrypted data.
